plugins.manifest:
# A toy first-party plugin for the Phase 4 tests (Epic 54, stories 54.22-54.26): one
# library stage that reads the library's videos and writes one row per video.
schema     = 1
id         = "tv.maktaba.toy"
version    = "0.0.0-dev"
plugin_api = "1.0"
maktaba    = ">=0.0.0"
licence    = "AGPL-3.0-only"
runtime    = "native-python"

[strings]
name    = "toy.name"
summary = "toy.summary"

[trusted]
runner    = "light"
component = "classify"
db.write  = ["fp_toy_out"]
settings  = ["groups"]
db.read   = ["videos", "app_settings"]

[[stage]]
name        = "fp_toy"
subject     = "library"
export      = "fp-toy"
version     = 1
label       = "Toy"
pool        = "cpu"
lane        = "seasons"
lane_order  = 99
placement   = "any"
entry       = "fp_toy.stage:IMPL"
fingerprint = { input = true }

statements.name: rules.read
statements.text: SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = $1

statements.name: stage.input_fingerprint
statements.text: SELECT id, size_bytes FROM videos WHERE library_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

statements.name: stage.run
statements.text: SELECT id, title, size_bytes FROM videos WHERE library_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

statements.name: stage.run.3
statements.text: INSERT INTO fp_toy_out (library_id, video_id, title, n) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)

en.toy.name: Toy
en.toy.summary: A toy stage for the tests.
